item.title: [IFC Films] Tangles | Teaser Trailer | Feat. Julia Louis-Dreyfus & Abbi Jacobson | Independent Film Company
item.description:
As Sarah (Jacobson) finds love and independence in 1990s San Francisco, a visit home reunites her with her vibrant mother Midge (Louis-Dreyfus) and the wonderfully imperfect family that shaped her. When Midge is diagnosed with Alzheimer's, Sarah discovers that while family is never simple, the ties that bind us — through laughter, heartbreak and joy — endure even as memories begin to fade.

Featuring an All-Star Voice Cast Led by Abbi Jacobson, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Beanie Feldstein, Seth Rogen and Samira Wiley.

item.title: [IFC Films] BEST PANCAKES IN THE COUNTY | Official Trailer | Feat. Nicolas Cage, Justin Long & Shelley Hennig
item.description:
Set over the course of one explosive night, BEST PANCAKES IN THE COUNTY transforms an unassuming small-town diner into the epicenter of a deadly standoff involving rogue federal agents, a fast-talking con man with a dangerous past and a waitress harboring secrets of her own. As loyalties blur and tensions erupt, survival depends on who can outthink — and outgun — everyone else.

Written and Directed by Ken Sanzel
Starring Academy Award® Winner Nicolas Cage, Justin Long and Shelley Hennig

In Theaters and On Digital Platforms November 20, 2026

item.title: [Pathe] Better Burn Mum - Official Trailer in HD
item.description:
A film by Albert DUPONTEL, with Louise COLDEFY, Julia PIATON, Artus and Albert DUPONTEL

In French Theaters on November 11th 2026

Two sisters and a brother, born into a family of undertakers, reunite for their mother’s funeral. When the staff goes on strike, they must take over the entire funeral process themselves, forcing them to confront one another, their memories, and everything left unsaid. How do you agree on how to say goodbye — and burn your own mother?

item.title: [Pathe] KARMA - Official trailer HD
item.description:
A film by Guillaume Canet with Marion Cotillard, Denis Menochet and Leonardo Sbaraglia

In French theaters on October 21st 2026

Festival de Cannes - 2026 official selection - Out of competition

In a village of northern Spain, Jeanne tries to rebuild her life with Daniel, who knows nothing about her troubled past. One day, Mateo, Jeanne’s six-year-old godson, mysteriously disappears… In order to escape the police, who instantly suspect her, Jeanne flees to France and hides out in the community where she grew up, led by Marc. Refusing to believe that the woman he loves is guilty, Daniel will do everything in his power to find her before the police do.

item.title: [IFC Films] MOUSE Official Trailer | Sophie Okonedo, Katherine Mallen Kupferer | Independent Film Company
item.description:
It's 2002, and best friends Minnie (Kupferer) and Callie (Coleman) are heading into their senior year of high school, with Minnie long living in the protective shadow of the charismatic and admired Callie. When their friendship is suddenly upended at the start of the summer, Minnie struggles to define her own identity and forms a complicated relationship with Callie’s poised, attentive mother (Okonedo), pulling her further from her own chaotic home.

Written By: Kelly O'Sullivan
Directed by Kelly O'Sullivan and Alex Thompson
Starring: Sophie Okonedo, Katherine Mallen Kupferer, Chloe Coleman, Tara Mallen, Iman Vellani, David Hyde Pierce

In Theaters November 6th.

item.title: [Park Circus] Twinless | UK & Ireland Official Trailer | Park Circus - In Cinemas 6 February
item.description:
Starring Dylan O'Brien and James Sweeney, TWINLESS is exclusively in cinemas across the UK & Ireland from 6 February 2026.

"A true original" – The Guardian
"One-of-a-kind" – Variety

After meeting in a twin bereavement support group, Roman (Dylan O'Brien) and Dennis (James Sweeney) develop an unlikely bromance as they both search for solace and an identity without their better halves. They soon become inseparable, but old wounds reopen that will have permanent consequences for their friendship. Lauren Graham and Aisling Franciosi also star in this stirring, whip-smart, wholly original dark-comedy from breakout multi hyphenate director James Sweeney.

#Twinless
